title: MUJHEY MATLOOB HOGA JAAM LAINA JAB BHI KAUSAR KA
body:
MUJHEY MATLOOB HOGA JAAM LAINA JAB BHI KAUSAR KA
SALAAM AISA PADHOONGA DIL BHAR AAYEGAA PAYAMBAR KA
<<DIVIDER>>
ZAMEEN-E-KARBALA KA POOCHNAA TERAY MUQADDAR KA
HAI TUJH MEIN AAJ TAKH MEHFOOZ SARMAAYA PAYAMBAR KA
<<DIVIDER>>
KAMAR QAM KYON NA HO DIL GHAM SE TOOTEY KYON NA SARWAR KA
ALAMBARDAAR AAKHIR BHAAYI THA BAAZOO BARAABAR KA
<<DIVIDER>>
LABAY DARYA ALAMBARDAAR BHI KAAM AAGAYA AAKHIR
BASAB ALLAH HAAFEZ HAZRAT-E-ZAINAB KI CHAADAR KA
<<DIVIDER>>
TERI GHAIRATH KO AAKHIR KYA HUVA KUCH TU NAY SONCHA BHI
BHARI MEHFIL MAI KAISA TAZKERA ZAINAB KI CHAADAR KA
<<DIVIDER>>
GHADI BHAR BHI RABAB AARAAM SEY SONAY NAHIN PAATHEE
WOH JAB KARWAT BADALTHI HAI KHAYAAL AATA HAI ASGHAR KA
<<DIVIDER>>
SAYEED ZAAR PAR JAB BHI KOYI UFTAAB PADTHI HAI
BAS EK AADATH SI HAI WOH NAAM LETHA HAI HYDER KA
